market.question: Will the highest temperature in Munich be 20°C on May 8?

assessment.reasoning: Munich May 8 forecast ~70°F = 21.1°C. Bucket '20°C' would capture 20.0-20.9°C, just below forecast. AccuWeather shows May 2026 highs ranging 16-24°C broadly. Forecast just above 20 bucket; 21°C bucket more likely.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Munich Airport vs city — airport tends slightly cooler at night but similar daytime highs. 1°C swing easy.
